# Crux Consulting

> AI-native business consulting. We help companies implement AI, automate processes, and build custom solutions that actually work.

## Pages

- [/](/): Homepage — AI-native business consulting services and value proposition.
- [/about](/about): About Crux Consulting — team, mission, and how we work.
- [/services](/services): Full services overview including AI chatbots, workshops, process audits, automation, AI compliance, and tender assistant.
- [/services/ai-chatbot](/services/ai-chatbot): AI chatbot and virtual assistant solutions for sales and customer service.
- [/services/workshops](/services/workshops): AI workshops and training programs for teams.
- [/services/process-audit](/services/process-audit): Business process analysis to identify automation and AI opportunities.
- [/services/automation](/services/automation): Workflow and task automation implementation.
- [/services/ai-compliance](/services/ai-compliance): AI governance, compliance, and risk management.
- [/en/services/tender-assistant](https://www.crux-consulting.ai/en/services/tender-assistant): Tender Assistant — AI-assisted tender management: fit and qualification assessment, requirement/deadline/document extraction into tasks, project management and auto-fill of recurring answers from approved company data, with human review. German: [/de/services/tender-assistant](https://www.crux-consulting.ai/de/services/tender-assistant).
- [/en/solutions/tender-analysis](https://www.crux-consulting.ai/en/solutions/tender-analysis): Analysing tender documents with AI (German: [/de/loesungen/ausschreibungen-analysieren](https://www.crux-consulting.ai/de/loesungen/ausschreibungen-analysieren)).
- [/en/solutions/tender-questionnaire-autofill](https://www.crux-consulting.ai/en/solutions/tender-questionnaire-autofill): Preparing tender forms and questionnaires from approved data, with expert sign-off; no automatic submission (German: [/de/loesungen/ausschreibungsformulare-ausfuellen](https://www.crux-consulting.ai/de/loesungen/ausschreibungsformulare-ausfuellen)).
- [/impressum](/impressum): Legal imprint and company information.
- [/privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy and data protection information.
